messages.author: 00bfe5510bbda690
messages.subject: Interpolation options and iglevel options
parts:
Hi all, 


We are going to use GGIR to analyse the UKbiobank dataset and would like your opinion on the differences between the parameter options. 

For iglevels we have simply used the default  "iglevels=c(seq(0,4000,by=25),8000)", is this the convention?

For the interpolation option, we do not know when to use "1=linear" or "2=nearest neighbour" and their pros & cons. 

Lastly, if you could provide any comments in general on why the defaults in GGIR are chosen as they are, that would be very helpful!


Warm regards, 
Po

I recently read this paper using both interpolation options, might be helpful: https://journals.humankinetics.com/view/journals/jmpb/4/4/article-p298.xml

Best,
Jairo
